text:
sam: Quick proposal — let's tweak the oncall handoff cadence to 30m daily instead of the long weekly deep dive, and add a short 15m shadowing session for new engineers. Thoughts?

mika: +1 for shadowing. can we do 09:15 PST slot for the shadow? easier for APAC overlap.

jordan: I prefer 30m every morning. proposed agenda: 1) open incidents quick status (5m) 2) blocked work (5m) 3) rollouts/changes (10m) 4) shadow pairing (10m). open to edits.

tess: FYI INC-1234 still flapping, needs oncall lead present. @jordan can you take point today? :warning:

oncall-bot: New incident assigned: INC-1234 -> jordan. Link: https://incidents.example.com/INC-1234 (details, timeline).

sam: Good catch. Also propose rotating escalation attendance so the same people aren't on every day — week A: eng-sre + runtime, week B: infra + platform. Keeps load balanced.

mika: +1 to rotation. small ask — can we have a 15-30m code-review ping window immediately after handoff for quick PRs? helps reduce context switching later.

jordan: I got INC-1234. I'll triage and update. Also, add 'post-mortem followups' as a Friday agenda item (5m) so we close action items.

tess: Can we trial this next week? Mon-Fri 09:30 PST 30m, shadowing Tue/Thu 09:15-09:30. If it's workable, we formalize rotation docs.

sam: Sounds good. I'll update the calendar and the Handoff doc. ping me if you can't attend.

mika: Heads up — I'm OOO Wednesday. Can someone cover my Tue shadow slot if it needs extra pair time? @tess?

tess: I can cover Tue but Thu looks tight. @jordan are you able to pick up Thu shadow?

jordan: I can do Thu. Quick calendar snippet to copy into invites:

```
Title: Oncall Daily Handoff
When: Mon-Fri 09:30-10:00 PST
Shadowing: Tue/Thu 09:15-09:30 PST
Attendees: oncall, eng-sre, runtime, infra (rotating)
Agenda: open incidents, blockers, rollouts, shadowing
```

sam: Perfect. I'll create the recurrence, add rotation tags, and put notes in /docs/oncall/handoff.md :link: .

mika: Thanks! :thumbsup:

tess: One more thing — add 'who's pausing deployments' to the agenda. that saved us last time.

sam: noted. trial starts Monday (we'll track attendance + incident response metrics). I'll post a short survey after the first week.

(End thread)
